category: Informasi Umum Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad
category_en: General Information about Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT)
question: Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad melayani apa saja?
question_en: What services does Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT) provide?
answer: ULT UNPAD menyediakan layanan terpadu bagi seluruh civitas academica UNPAD, meliputi mahasiswa, dosen, dan tenaga kependidikan, serta masyarakat umum. Layanan ULT mencakup penerimaan dan penyelesaian berbagai kebutuhan pelayanan publik yang berkaitan dengan administrasi dan layanan universitas, baik secara luring maupun daring.
answer_en: ULT Unpad provides integrated services for the entire Unpad academic community, including students, lecturers, education staff, and the general public. ULT receives and handles various public service needs related to university administration and services, both in person and online.

category: Informasi Umum Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad
category_en: General Information about Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT)
question: Kapan jam operasional Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad?
question_en: What are Unpad ULT's operating hours?
answer: Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad beroperasi pada hari Senin–Kamis pukul 08.30–16.00 WIB dan Jumat pukul 08.30–16.30 WIB.
answer_en: Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT) operates Monday–Thursday from 8:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. WIB and Friday from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. WIB.

category: Informasi Umum Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad
category_en: General Information about Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT)
question: Di mana lokasi Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad?
question_en: Where is Unpad ULT located?
answer: Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad terletak di Gedung Rektorat Universitas Padjadjaran lantai 1.
answer_en: Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT) is located on the first floor of the Universitas Padjadjaran Rectorate Building.

category: Informasi Umum Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad
category_en: General Information about Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT)
question: Anda dapat menghubungi Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad melalui:
question_en: How can I contact Unpad ULT?
answer:
Anda dapat menghubungi Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad melalui:

WhatsApp Unpad Official: 0811-2230-1410
WhatsApp Layanan ULT: 0811-2230-1383 dan 0811-2230-1384
answer_en:
You can contact Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT) through:

Unpad Official WhatsApp: 0811-2230-1410
ULT Service WhatsApp: 0811-2230-1383 and 0811-2230-1384

category: Informasi Umum Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad
category_en: General Information about Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT)
question: Apakah Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad memiliki layanan disabilitas?
question_en: Does Unpad ULT provide disability services?
answer: Tentu. Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad menyediakan layanan bagi penyandang disabilitas, baik secara luring dengan datang langsung ke kantor ULT maupun secara daring melalui WhatsApp Layanan Disabilitas di 0811-2230-1382.
answer_en: Yes. Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT) provides services for persons with disabilities, either in person at the ULT office or online through the Disability Service WhatsApp number at 0811-2230-1382.

category: Informasi Umum Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad
category_en: General Information about Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT)
question: Apakah layanan ULT dikenakan biaya?
question_en: Are ULT services subject to a fee?
answer: Tidak. Seluruh layanan ULT tidak dikenakan biaya.
answer_en: No. All ULT services are free of charge.

category: Informasi Umum Unit Layanan Terpadu (ULT) Unpad
category_en: General Information about Unpad's Integrated Service Unit (ULT)
question: Bagaimana tata cara layanan ULT secara luring?
question_en: What is the procedure for receiving ULT services in person?
answer: Untuk mendapatkan layanan ULT secara luring, silakan datang langsung ke kantor ULT dan mengambil nomor antrean (ticketing) sesuai dengan kategori layanan yang dibutuhkan. Selanjutnya, tunggu hingga nomor antrean dipanggil, kemudian menuju loket sesuai dengan panggilan untuk mendapatkan pelayanan dari petugas ULT.
answer_en: To receive an in-person ULT service, visit the ULT office and take a queue number according to the service category you need. Wait until your number is called, then proceed to the designated counter to receive assistance from a ULT officer.

question: Apa sanksinya apabila tidak melakukan registrasi mahasiswa baru sesuai jadwal dan ketentuan?
question_en: What happens if I do not complete new student registration according to the schedule and requirements?
answer: Akan dianggap mengundurkan diri.
answer_en: You will be considered to have withdrawn.

question: Apakah bisa alih prodi ketikan sudah dinyatakan Lulus Masuk UNPAD
question_en: Can I change study programs after I have been admitted to Unpad?
answer: Alih Prodi baru diperkenankan Mulai semester 3 dan 4
answer_en: A change of study program is only permitted starting in the third or fourth semester.

question: Aapakah pendaftar Reguler SMUP bisa mengajukan KIP-K
question_en: Can regular SMUP applicants apply for KIP-K?
answer: Tidak bisa
answer_en: No, they cannot.

question: Pengajuan Pengunduran diri di Unpad bagaimana ?
question_en: How do I submit a withdrawal request from Unpad?
answer: Silakan berkirim surat melalui email ke wr1@unpad.ac.id
answer_en: Please send a letter by email to wr1@unpad.ac.id.

question: Bagaimana cara mendapatkan surat keterangan di terima di Universitas (LoA)
question_en: How can I obtain a Letter of Acceptance (LoA) from the university?
answer: Peserta dapat download mandiri di laman https://students.unpad.ac.id/peserta menu Download, Jika tidak muncul silahkan mengajukan permohonan dengan menyertakan Nama, Nomor Peserta, Program Studi ke email dit.akademik@unpad.ac.id
answer_en: Participants can download it from https://students.unpad.ac.id/peserta under the Download menu. If it does not appear, submit a request containing your name, participant number, and study program to dit.akademik@unpad.ac.id.

question: Bagaimana cara mengajukan Defer/Tunda Kuliah (Pascasarjana)
question_en: How do I request a study deferral for a postgraduate program?
answer: Peserta lulus seleksi, yang memerlukan LoA silahkan mengajukan permohonan dengan menyertakan Nama, Nomor Peserta, Program Studi ke email dit.akademik@unpad.ac.id
answer_en: Successful applicants who require an LoA should submit a request containing their name, participant number, and study program to dit.akademik@unpad.ac.id.

question: Jalur Masuk apa saja yang ditawarkan Unpad?
question_en: Which admission pathways does Unpad offer?
answer: Jalur masuk bagi calon mahasiswa baru Universitas Padjadjaran bisa melalui jalur SNMPTN, SBMPTN dan SMUP. Untuk mengetahui info mengenai penerimaan siswa baru di Unpad bisa dilihat melalui website https://www.smup.unpad.ac.id/
answer_en: Prospective Universitas Padjadjaran students can apply through the SNMPTN, SBMPTN, or SMUP admission pathways. Information about new student admissions is available at https://www.smup.unpad.ac.id/.

question: Bagaimana cara mendapatkan surat keterangan sedang tidak menerima beasiswa
question_en: How can I obtain a statement confirming that I am not receiving a scholarship?
answer: Silakan bisa mengajukan melaui Prodi atau fakultas masing-masing
answer_en: Please submit a request through your respective study program or faculty.

question: Setelah dinyatakan diterima jalur SNBP (Seleksi Nasional Berdasarkan Prestasi), apakah bisa mendaftar SNBT/MANDIRI?
question_en: If I have been admitted through SNBP, can I register for SNBT or the Independent Admission Track?
answer: Siswa yang dinyatakan lulus seleksi pada jalur SNBP, tidak bisa mendaftar untuk mengikuti penerimaan mahasiswa baru jalur SNBT (Seleksi Nasional Berdasarkan Tes) maupun Jalur Mandiri
answer_en: Students who are admitted through SNBP cannot register for new student admission through SNBT or the Independent Admission Track.

question: saya lupa Paus Name, Bagaimana cara mengetahui Paus Name
question_en: I forgot my PAuS Name. How can I find it?
answer: Jika Anda lupa akun PAuS Universitas Padjadjaran, Anda dapat memulihkan PAuS Name melalui https://paus.unpad.ac.id/forgot/paus-name/ dan reset password di https://paus.unpad.ac.id/forgot/password/, nanti akan ada Notif melalui email atau SMS sesuai yang diisikan, jika belum mengisi no HP dan email silakan kirim tiket layanan di siat.unpad.ac.id/layanan (Pastikan mencantumkan Nama lengkap dan NPM)
answer_en: If you forget your Universitas Padjadjaran PAuS account, recover your PAuS Name at https://paus.unpad.ac.id/forgot/paus-name/ or reset your password at https://paus.unpad.ac.id/forgot/password/. A notification will be sent by email or SMS using the details you provided. If you have not provided a mobile phone number and email address, submit a service ticket at https://siat.unpad.ac.id/layanan and include your full name and student ID number (NPM).

question: Apakah Bisa mengajukan penurunan UKT dan IPI
question_en: Can I request a reduction in UKT and IPI?
answer: Untuk jalur Mandiri tidak ada keringanan UKT dan IP
answer_en: UKT and IPI reductions are not available for the Independent Admission Track.

question: Saya Mahasiswa Baru, tapi saya Alumni Unpad, Apakah saya harus membuat PAUS ID kembali?
question_en: I am a new student and a Unpad alumnus. Do I need to create a new PAuS ID?
answer: Tidak, Silakan menggunakan Paus Name yang ada tinggal masuk Menu Validasi, Registrasi Tambahan Pilih Akun Mahasiswa kemuadian Upload KTM Baru nya
answer_en: No. Use your existing PAuS Name, open the Validation menu, select Additional Registration, choose Student Account, and upload your new student ID card (KTM).

question: Bagaimana cara membuat PAUS ID?
question_en: How do I create a PAuS ID?
answer: Silakan registrasi melalui https://paus.unpad.ac.id/registration, Untuk lebih lanjut silakan bisa akses laman https://support.unpad.ac.id/how-to/paus-registrasi/paus-registrasi-mahasiswa/
answer_en: Register at https://paus.unpad.ac.id/registration. For further guidance, visit https://support.unpad.ac.id/how-to/paus-registrasi/paus-registrasi-mahasiswa/.

question: Bagaimana jika terlambat membayar UKT dan KRS
question_en: What should I do if I am late paying UKT or submitting my study plan (KRS)?
answer: Silahkan datang/menghubungi Prodi untuk mendapatkan Surat Rekomendasi untuk Pembukaan Tagihan dan KRS Susulan jika pembayaran UKT dan KRS melebihi tenggat waktu
answer_en: Visit or contact your study program to obtain a recommendation letter for reopening the tuition bill and arranging a late KRS submission if you missed the UKT payment or KRS deadline.

question: Bagaimana cara mengurus KTM hilang/rusak?
question_en: How do I replace a lost or damaged student ID card (KTM)?
answer: Silakan langsung ke Bank Penerbit masing-masing dengan membawa surat kehilangan dari pihak berwajib.
answer_en: Visit the issuing bank and bring a loss report from the relevant authority.

question: Tanggal berapa saja masa pembayaran her-registrasi?
question_en: When is the re-registration payment period?
answer: Untuk semester genap, pembayaran her-registrasi dapat dilakukan pada Bulan Januari , Untuk semester ganjil, pembayaran her-registrasi dapat dilakukan pada Bulan Juli
answer_en: For the even semester, re-registration payments can be made in January. For the odd semester, payments can be made in July.

question: Bagaimana Cara mengajukan Cuti Kuliah
question_en: How do I apply for academic leave?
answer:
Pengajuan cuti akademik di Unpad dilakukan dengan langkah berikut:
1. Mahasiswa mengajukan surat permohonan cuti akademik kepada Ketua Program Studi melalui email resmi program studi. Format surat biasanya tersedia di situs fakultas terkait.
2. Program Studi akan memverifikasi status aktif mahasiswa dan meneruskan permohonan ke Wakil Dekan untuk persetujuan.
3. Setelah disetujui, mahasiswa diberi SK Cuti.
4. Cuti biasanya maksimal semester dan tidak diperbolehkan pada dua semester pertama studi.
5. Persyaratan dan prosedur tambahan dapat berbeda tiap fakultas atau program studi.
answer_en:
To apply for academic leave at Unpad:
1. Submit an academic leave request letter to the Head of the Study Program through the study program's official email address. The letter template is usually available on the relevant faculty website.
2. The study program will verify your active status and forward the request to the Vice Dean for approval.
3. Once approved, you will receive an Academic Leave Decree.
4. Academic leave is generally limited by semester and is not permitted during the first two semesters of study.
5. Additional requirements and procedures may vary by faculty or study program.

question: Bagaimana cara mendapat informasi mengenai beasiswa di Unpad?
question_en: Where can I find information about scholarships at Unpad?
answer: Informasi mengenai beasiswa di Unpad dapat dilihat pada website https://www.beasiswa.unpad.ac.id/
answer_en: Information about scholarships at Unpad is available at https://www.beasiswa.unpad.ac.id/.

question: Bagaimana cara alih Alih Prodi
question_en: How do I request a change of study program?
answer: Terkait alih prodi silakan membuat permohonan yang di tujukan ke Ketu Program Studi (Podi), Nanti Prodi akan berkirim surat ke Fakultas dari Fakultas ke Universita
answer_en: Submit a request addressed to the Head of your Study Program. The study program will forward the letter to the faculty, which will then forward it to the university.

question: Bagaimana cara undur diri
question_en: How do I withdraw from the university?
answer: Silahkan datang/menghubungi Prodi masing-masing
answer_en: Visit or contact your respective study program.

question: Bagaimana Cara mendapatkan surat keterangan aktif kuliah
question_en: How can I obtain an active student status letter?
answer: Silakan bisa melalui Prodi masing-masing, surat keterangan aktif kuliah di keluarkan oleh Fakultas
answer_en: Submit a request through your respective study program. The faculty issues the active student status letter.

question: Bagaimana cara melakukan legalisir ijazah/transkrip nilai?
question_en: How do I legalize my diploma or academic transcript?
answer: Dapat menghubungi Akademik Fakultas masing-masing
answer_en: Contact the academic administration office of your respective faculty.

question: Dimanakah saya bisa mengambil ijazah setelah saya wisuda?
question_en: Where can I collect my diploma after graduation?
answer: Untuk pengambilan ijazah bagi mahasiswa yang sudah menyelesaikan studinya bisa menghubungi Unit Layanan Terpadu Unpad, dengan membawa surat pengantar pengambilan Ijazah dan Transkrip dari Fakultas masing-masing.
answer_en: Graduates can collect their diploma from Unpad's Integrated Service Unit. Bring a diploma and transcript collection letter from your respective faculty.

question: Apakah toga diperjual belikan?
question_en: Can graduation gowns be purchased?
answer:
Tidak, toga di Universitas Padjadjatan tidak tersedia untuk diperjual belikan. Toga hanya tersedia untuk dipinjamkan sesuai
dengan waktu wisuda yang tersedia.
answer_en: No. Universitas Padjadjaran does not sell graduation gowns. Gowns are only available on loan according to the applicable graduation schedule.

question: Dimanakah saya bisa mendapatkan info mengenai gelombang wisuda?
question_en: Where can I find information about graduation periods?
answer: Untuk informasi mengenai gelombang wisuda, bisa melihat melalui instagram @universitaspadjadjaran
answer_en: Information about graduation periods is available on Instagram at @universitaspadjadjaran.

question: Bagaimanakah alur peminjaman toga untuk wisuda?
question_en: What is the process for borrowing a graduation gown?
answer: Untuk informasi mengenai alur peminjaman toga untuk wisuda, beserta waktu peminjaman bisa untuk melihat unggahan di instagram @universitaspadjadjaran
answer_en: Information about the gown borrowing procedure and schedule is available in posts on Instagram at @universitaspadjadjaran.

question: Aapakah pengambilan Ijazah dan Transktip Bisa di kuasakan ?
question_en: Can someone else collect my diploma and transcript on my behalf?
answer:
Membawa surat pengantar pengambilan Ijazah dan Transkrip dari Fakultas masing-masing.
Untuk pengambilan yang dikuasakan wajib membuat surat kuasa di atas materai Rp. 10.000,- serta fotocopy KTP pemberi kuasa dan penerima kuasa.
answer_en: Bring a diploma and transcript collection letter from your respective faculty. If collection is delegated to another person, you must prepare a power of attorney bearing a Rp10,000 duty stamp and copies of the identity cards of both the person granting and the person receiving the authorization.

question: Apakah Ada Format Surat Kuasa ?
question_en: Is there a standard power of attorney template?
answer: Tidak ada Formast surat Kuasa Baku, silakan bebas
answer_en: No standard template is provided. You may use your own format.

question: Ijazah dan Transkrip saya Hilang, apakah bisa di cetak kembali ?
question_en: I lost my diploma or transcript. Can it be reissued?
answer: Silakan bisa menghubungi Fakultas masing-masing untuk Proses cetak Duplikast Ijazah atau Transkrip
answer_en: Contact your respective faculty to request a duplicate diploma or transcript.

question: Nama saya tidak muncul di laman PDDIKTI
question_en: My name does not appear on PDDIKTI. What should I do?
answer:
Terkait pendataan layanan PDDIKTI di Universitas Padjadjaran terdiri dari :

Layanan Perubahan Data Pokok Mahasiswa/Alumni
Layanan Pendataan Mahasiswa/Alumni di PDDIKTI
Layanan Update Data Perkuliahan Mahasiswa/Alumi
Layanan Perubahan Jenis Keluar Mahasiswa/Alumni
Layanan Update Kelengkapan Status Lulus Mahasiswa/Alumni
Layanan Surat Keterangan Alumni di PDDIKTI
Untuk memproses lebih lanjut, kami mohon kesediaan Anda untuk mengisi formulir Google Form di bawah ini. Formulir ini digunakan sebagai dokumen lampiran untuk surat ajuan dari universitas yang akan ditujukan kepada DIKTI.

https://bit.ly/LayananPDDIKTIUnpad

Pastikan informasi yang Anda berikan adalah akurat dan lengkap
answer_en:
Universitas Padjadjaran provides the following PDDIKTI data services:

Changes to primary student or alumni data
Registration of students or alumni in PDDIKTI
Updates to student or alumni course data
Changes to the type of student or alumni exit status
Updates to the completeness of student or alumni graduation status
Alumni statement letters in PDDIKTI

To continue the process, complete the form at https://bit.ly/LayananPDDIKTIUnpad. The form will be attached to the university's submission letter to DIKTI. Make sure that the information you provide is accurate and complete.

question: Apakah Ijazah saya sudah bisa diambil ?
question_en: Is my diploma ready for collection?
answer: Jika Ijazah dan Transkrip sudah bisa di download diakun students masing-masing (bukan yang masih draf)
answer_en: Your diploma is ready for collection if the final diploma and transcript, rather than draft versions, are available for download from your students account.
